JMFC, SINDHANUR AND ALSO QUASH THE FIR NO.220/2019 REGISTERED BY THE IST RESPONDENT POLICE IN CRIME NO.64/2019 FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/SEC.420, 406, 407, 408, 409, 107, 108, 115, 120B R/W 34 OF IPC AND CONSEQUENTLY BE PLEASED TO ACQUIT THE PETITIONER.

THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

This petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. is filed to quash the proceedings in P.C. No.07/2019 pending on the file of Prl.C.J. JMFC, Sindhanur and also the FIR No.220/2019 registered by the 1st respondent Police in Crime No.64/2019 for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 406, 407,
408, 409, 107, 108, 115 and 120B R/w Section 34 of IPC.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner- accused No.1 and the learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent Nos.1 and 2-State .
3.
The allegation against the petitioner-accused No.1 and other accused is that, they obtained loan from the Bank by furnishing created warehouse receipt.
The veracity of the allegations can be considered only after investigation and at this stage, the registration of FIR does not warrant any interference.
In view of dismissal of the petition, pending interlocutory applications, if any, do not survive for consideration.
